_about: Quest hubs, 17 Nov 2026: the Aspen Wilderness's scouts and runners report back to Longstand Camp, so these accept lines say which way to go from it.

asp_broken_dams.accept_text: The dencarvers are down at the third pond on the Beaverdam Benches, a long way south of camp down the valley, and they've got good at it, which is the part that bothers me. Bring the timber back up when you're done. The beavers will rebuild, they always do, but they rebuild faster with their own sticks.
